decisions.reason: The multi-model bleaching tray line has its own page and sits in the firm's core thermoforming range for dental labs, so the visible commitment and sunk development favor persistence even without recent website evidence.
The PETG blank is a low-cost complement to the established thermoforming portfolio and was featured prominently, so there is little pressure to withdraw it.
The UV-curing lacquer carries lower public commitment, but as a cheap consumable supporting the announced digital workflow, weak results can still be read as temporary adoption lag.
Custom earmolds are central to the firm's custom-device manufacturing identity, and the investment in a multi-model line encourages continued commitment.
Custom hearing protection uses existing earmold production capabilities and serves growing markets, so management would attribute any shortfall to pandemic-related disruption and market build-up.
